cases.name: Debra Kay Leonard
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "She married her-now-ex husband Thomas Leonard on October 7th, 1972 and had three children during this marriage: Michael, Kelly, and Kyle. While raising three children, Debra went to school for nursing at Delaware Technical Community College in Dover. Debra began a career in nursing that fully embraced her natural nurturing and care taking qualities. She worked at Christiana Care for over 25 years, where colleagues described her as not only a wonderful and caring nurse but also a great friend with a radiant smile.

Debra was generous, loving, and gave everything she could to support her family and friends. She enjoyed traveling, especially to see her grandchildren Cooper and Quinn, and was looking forward to retirement so she could see them more often. From her kitchen window, she would watch birds eat from her feeders and took great pleasure and comfort in seeing them. Debra would get "hangry", was a Cirque du Soleil superfan, and thought Sean Connery was the best James Bond.

Debra lived her life with love, hope, and kindness. She would want her loved ones to live by these virtues as well, especially in these dark days."
